title: Lovász determinant vanishes without a matching
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix whose associated bipartite graph has no perfect matching. For any weights $a_{i,j}\in R$, form the matrix with entry $a_{i,j}$ when $A_{i,j}=\mathrm{true}$ and zero otherwise. Its determinant is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The associated bipartite graph has no perfect matching
Weights $a_{i,j}$ in $R$ are given for all index pairs
